answer: The cedar assignment is published and whisper records each panel. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the orchard graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 2441 identities would post 4240 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
